name: Tachibana Hakana
source:
A woman who approached Takurou when he was alone and depressed in the park. She has a calm personality and is friendly to everyone. She is always looking for someone who can depend on her.

[Translated from [url=http://amatures.ohimesama.net/saimin/]Official site[/url]]
